question: What do I need to bring to the CS 1110 prelim on Thursday?
page:
CS 1110 Prelim 2 - Thursday, November 19, 7:30 PM
Location: Statler Auditorium (last names A-M), Bailey Hall (N-Z).
The exam covers lectures 13 through 22 and assignments A4 and A5.
Bring your Cornell student ID; we will check it at the door.
You will also need a pencil; exams written in pen will not be regraded.
No calculators, notes or phones are allowed.
Review session: Tuesday 7pm in Gates G01.
